messages:
Nina: Quick follow-up from the design critique this morning. Two focused items for Credentials: (1) the kebab/action layout at narrow widths, (2) revoke/rotate wording + undo accessibility. Wanted to capture consensus and small fixes.

Carlos: Observed on 768px the row wraps and the kebab drops to the next line which makes keyboard users lose context. Proposal: keep a single-line layout by truncating secondary meta and showing icons only for actions under 800px.

Mira: Keyboard flow bug: after the name the next tabbable is the inline reveal which pops a tooltip and steals focus. We should reorder to: checkbox -> name -> actions kebab -> copy -> reveal. Reveal can be removed from tab order (focusable via menu) but must stay reachable for screen-reader users via aria-controls.

Devon: For mobile we can collapse created-by/date into an overflow on each row. Agree not to hide copy-to-clipboard; it's used heavily during deploy. I'll add 32px minimum hit targets for all icons.

Samir: Revoke modal draft copy: 
"Title: Revoke API key"
"Body: Revoking this key disables it immediately. You will have 10 seconds to undo this action."
"Primary: Revoke key"
"Secondary: Cancel"
Make the warning copy larger to meet contrast. Include aria-describedby referencing the detailed explanation.

Nina: Undo toast copy suggestion: "Key revoked — Undo" with an explicit focusable button labeled "Undo revoke" and placed before the auto-dismiss timer. Also add an aria-live update: "Credential revoked. Undo available."

Carlos: Small visual polish request: add a 1px divider (#E6E9EF) between main content and actions at all widths so the kebab reads as an action area, not metadata. Increase dense row padding to 12px for better touch targets.

Mira: Accessibility additions: revoke modal should include role="alertdialog" and aria-modal="true" and an offscreen heading that reads "Revoke API key: irreversible". The toast should use polite aria-live and shift focus to the undo button when it appears if the user is still within the table.

Devon: Backend note: we can soft-delete for 10s to support undo. Need to ensure audit logs reflect the soft-delete and final delete. Will coordinate with security on retention semantics.

access-bot: Accessibility check: possible contrast failure on small revoke helper text (A11Y:CONTRAST_LOW). Please re-run color token tests after copy change.

Nina: Thanks team — I'll update the Figma comps with the dense variant, revised modal copy, and the toast behavior. I'll open two tickets: (1) compact rows + keyboard/order + hit targets, (2) revoke/rotate copy + aria role + undo toast behavior. @Devon please estimate effort for both by EOD. :thumbsup:
